content: How does one achieve enlightenment? By not seeking it. For whoever seeks it assumes that he does not already have it.
author: Alan Watts
story:
A former Anglican priest who immersed himself in Eastern philosophy, Alan Watts became a pioneering voice in mid-century California, bridging Taoism, Vedanta, and Zen with Western psychology. Confronting the frantic anxieties of modern consumerism and mechanistic materialism, Watts illuminated the illusion of the separate ego, inviting people to realize they are the entire cosmos experiencing itself.

This insight points directly back to the quiet center of being. Alan Watts observed that while the mind perpetually scatters itself into past regrets and future anxieties, peace is only ever discovered by anchoring attention in the immediate truth of this moment.
reflectionPrompt: What quiet yearning in your heart is asking for your attention and honest devotion?
